sub.h: Pattern of growth¥: Symmetric vs Asymmetric IUGR
sub.html:
Symmetric¥Asymmetric¥
Growth patternHead circumference, length, and weight proportionally decreasedHead circumference is spared relative to decreased weight, length
TimingUsually occurs early in pregnancy (1st or 2nd trimester)Usually occurs later in pregnancy (3rd trimester)
CausesCauses: Intrinsic fetal factors (i.e. genetic) or first-trimester insult (e.g. infection)Causes: Often due to maternal factors. Thought to result from adaptation to an unfavourable environment late in pregnancy
